Overview

Dhaulagiri I Expedition

Dhaulagiri I is the seventh-highest of the internationally recognised fourteen 8,000-metre peaks. Its western Nepal setting is remote and access can be affected by road and weather conditions.

The normal expedition approach often uses the Myagdi valley and Italian Base Camp before reaching the mountain’s main climbing base. The route above involves glacier travel, high camps and exposed snow and ice.

This outline is adaptable, and may change with seasonal access, weather and the expedition leader’s decisions.

Contact our team for the current itinerary, dates, equipment requirements and availability.
